words.grammar: hit a peak at + 时间
the high point of + 名词
collocations: the high point of the day

patterns.frame: The darkest cell is {row} at {col} — that is the peak.
patterns.zh_frame: 最深的格子是 {row} 的 {col}，那就是峰值。
活动在 {col} 达到峰值，{row}为 {value}。

traps.why_zh: peak 作动词不用 be；作名词才说 reach a peak。

registers.general: It is busiest at {col} in {row} — that cell is the darkest.
registers.ielts: The heatmap peaks at {col}, when {row} reaches {value}.
registers.business: {row} peaks at {col}, at {value}, so that is the window to staff.

words.note_zh: peak 的反义，书面图表词。

patterns.frame: The lightest cell is {row} at {col} — almost nobody there.
patterns.zh_frame: 最浅的格子是 {row} 的 {col}，几乎没人。

patterns.frame: The lowest value falls at {col}, when {row} drops to {value}.

traps.why_zh: 时段用 quiet/busiest，不说 lowest hour。

registers.general: {row} is dead at {col} — the cells are almost white.
registers.ielts: Activity drops to its lowest point at {col}, when {row} stands at {value}.
registers.business: {row} bottoms out at {col}, so that is a safe window for maintenance.

words.grammar: a high concentration of + 名词

patterns.frame: Most of the activity happens in a small block around {col}.
patterns.zh_frame: 大部分活动挤在 {col} 前后的一小块。

patterns.frame: Activity is heavily concentrated around {col}, where {row} reaches {value}.

traps.wrong_en: The traffic is concentrated in noon.
traps.right_en: The traffic is concentrated at noon.

registers.general: Most of the activity is packed into a small block around {col}.
registers.ielts: Activity is concentrated around {col}, when {row} reaches {value}.
registers.business: Demand is concentrated in a narrow window around {col}, which is why staffing looks lopsided.

patterns.frame: The color goes from light to dark as the values get bigger.
The shading deepens from {row} across the row, with the highest intensity at {col}.
patterns.zh_frame: 颜色沿 {row} 逐渐加深，{col}强度最高。

traps.why_zh: 颜色深浅用 dark/light，不用 heavy。

registers.general: The color fades from dark to light as you move across the row.
registers.ielts: The shading deepens toward {col}, where the value reaches {value}.
registers.business: The map goes from pale to deep around {col}; that is where demand concentrates.

collocations: the pattern pops out at you

words.grammar: a dark streak across the row

patterns.frame: Every week looks the same: the dark band shows up around {col}.
patterns.zh_frame: 每周都一样，{col} 前后出现深色带。

patterns.frame: A recurring pattern emerges: the same rows darken at {col} and stay pale elsewhere.
patterns.zh_frame: 出现重复规律：同样的行在 {col} 变深，其余保持浅色。

traps.wrong_en: The pattern is happened every Monday.
traps.why_zh: happen 不用被动；pattern 配 repeat/recur。

registers.general: Every week looks the same: a dark band shows up at {col}.
registers.ielts: A clear weekly pattern is visible, with activity concentrated at {col}.
registers.business: The weekly pattern is stable, so scheduling can be planned around it.

words.grammar: put + 名词 + side by side
collocations: put two years side by side
whereas last year it was 8 a.m.

patterns.frame: Compared with other columns, {col} is darker in {row}.
patterns.zh_frame: 和其他列相比，{row}在 {col} 更深。

patterns.frame: Relative to other columns, {col} shows a higher value in {row}, at {value}.
patterns.zh_frame: 相对其他列，{row}在 {col} 的数值更高，为 {value}。

traps.wrong_en: Compared with 2020, the peak moved at 9 a.m.
traps.right_en: Compared with 2020, the peak moved to 9 a.m.
traps.why_zh: 移动终点用 moved to + 时间点。

registers.general: Compared with the other columns, {col} is darker in {row}.
registers.ielts: Relative to other columns, {col} records a higher value in {row}, at {value}.
registers.business: {col} is the stronger column for {row}; the rest of the week is quieter.

traps.wrong_en: The value is high at Friday.
traps.right_en: The value is high on Friday.

comparisons.meaning_zh: peak 是峰值，可作名词或动词；peak hour 是固定搭配“高峰时段”。
comparisons.grammar_zh: peak at 8 p.m.（动词）；at peak hours（名词短语）
comparisons.collocations_zh: peak at noon / peak hours / rush hour
comparisons.usage_zh: 说“在峰值”用 at its peak；日常高峰更常说 rush hour。

examples.en: Orders peak at 8 p.m., and the store is busiest during peak hours.
examples.zh: 订单在晚上 8 点达到峰值，门店在高峰时段最忙。

comparisons.meaning_zh: at 配具体时刻，in 配时段或月年，on 配具体某天。
comparisons.grammar_zh: at noon / at 8 p.m.；in the morning / in July；on Monday
comparisons.collocations_zh: at noon / in the morning / on Monday / at night（固定例外）
comparisons.usage_zh: 时刻用 at，时段用 in，天用 on；at night 不加 the。

examples.en: Orders are highest on Monday at noon.

comparisons.meaning_zh: high 指数值或水平高；heavy 指量大、强度大。
comparisons.usage_zh: 热力图颜色深说 dark 或 intense，不说 heavy color；交通量用 heavy。

examples.en: Traffic is heavy at 6 p.m., when volume is at its highest.
examples.zh: 傍晚 6 点交通量大，也是流量最高的时候。

comparisons.meaning_zh: concentrate 强调集中到一处；cluster 指一群点挨在一起。
comparisons.collocations_zh: be concentrated at noon / cluster around the center
comparisons.usage_zh: 热力图说 activity is concentrated at noon；散点说 points cluster in the corner。

examples.en: Activity is concentrated at noon, and most points cluster in the middle.
examples.zh: 活动集中在中午，大多数点聚集在中间。

comparisons.meaning_zh: most 指数量最多；highest 指水平或数值最高。
comparisons.grammar_zh: the most + 可数复数；the highest + level/value/number
comparisons.collocations_zh: the most orders / the highest value
comparisons.usage_zh: 热力图说 the highest value，不说 the most value。

examples.en: The highest value sits at 6 p.m., when most riders travel.
examples.zh: 最高值出现在傍晚 6 点，也是大多数乘客出行的时候。

comparisons.meaning_zh: proportion 是比例，可为分数或小数；percentage 必须能和百分数对应。
comparisons.grammar_zh: the proportion of A in B；the percentage of A
comparisons.collocations_zh: a high proportion of / the percentage of students
comparisons.usage_zh: 说 a high proportion 不用具体数；percentage 后常出现具体百分数。

examples.en: A high proportion of activity is concentrated at noon; the percentage reaches 45 percent.
examples.zh: 很大比例的活动集中在中午，占比达到 45%。
